blog.content:
# Getting Started with Next.js 15

Next.js 15 brings exciting new features and improvements. In this post, we'll explore the key updates and how to get started.

## What's New

- Improved App Router
- Enhanced performance
- Better TypeScript support

## Installation

\`\`\`bash
npx create-next-app@latest my-app
\`\`\`

Start building amazing applications today!

# Building Scalable React Applications

Learn the best practices for building maintainable and scalable React applications.

## Key Principles

1. Component composition
2. State management
3. Code organization
4. Performance optimization

## Conclusion

Following these principles will help you build better React applications.
